title: AI Companies Really, Really Want to Buy Your Work Files and Emails
summary: Data brokers are collecting all sorts of internal corporate files to help train AI models. Not everyone is thrilled.
llm_summary: AI firms are swooping in on data‑broker services that scrape and sell internal corporate documents—like work files, project plans, and email archives—to train their large‑language models. By aggregating this confidential material, the companies can boost AI performance, but the practice raises serious concerns about privacy, intellectual‑property theft, and corporate security.
